We are currently looking for a Receptionist for a temporary replacement to join a lovely international company located near Avenue Louise in Brussels.
 

As the first point of contact for visitors and colleagues, you will play an important role in ensuring a warm welcome and the smooth day-to-day running of the office. You will work in a pleasant, professional and English-speaking environment.
 

Your responsibilities
 

Welcome visitors and ensure a professional and friendly reception.
 

Answer incoming calls and handle general enquiries.
 

Manage incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries.
 

Coordinate meeting rooms and assist with appointments.
 

Provide general administrative support to the team.
 

Help maintain an organised and welcoming office environment.

You have previous experience in reception, front-office or administrative support.
 

You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.
 

You have excellent communication and organisational skills.
 

You are service-oriented, proactive and flexible.
 

You are comfortable working in an international environment and handling several tasks simultaneously.
 

You are available for a temporary replacement.

Assistant Housekeeping Manager (m/f/x)Job DescriptionYour Focus: The well-being of guests and employees. You will assist with the coordination and management of the Housekeeping department.In addition, you will be responsible for:- Sharing responsibility for ordering and deliveries within the Housekeeping department- Collaborating with internal and external cleaning staff- Ensuring and implementing Motel One’s housekeeping standards, as well as being responsible for cleanliness in all areas- Sharing responsibility for conducting internal coaching sessions, cross-training, and onboarding new housekeeping employees- Gaining cross-departmental insights into new areas of work through collaboration in our multicultural teamsBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.QualificationsWhether you’re a seasoned hotel professional or looking to change careers—you’re a great fit for us! That’s because personality and hospitality skills are our top priorities! You also stand out because of:- Training in the hotel industry or professional experience in the hotel, restaurant, or retail sectors, or an interest in changing careers.- A passion for developing employees—ideally with some initial leadership experience- A strong focus on quality and service, as well as hospitality skills and a passion for the hotel industry- An open, communicative demeanor, good manners, and strong verbal and written communication skills in French and English.The ability to work well in a team and a willingness to provide cross-departmental support—we achieve our success together.

F&B ManagerJob DescriptionAs the F&B Manager at The Cloud One Hotels, you are entrusted with overseeing all F&B outlets. Alongside your team, you'll delight our guests with our locally sourced organic breakfast or the nightly "Sounds in the Clouds," featuring captivating beats at our bar. Your key responsibilities include:- Orchestrating, coordinating, and supervising operational workflows across our F&B outlets- Leadership and development of the F&B team, including recruitment, onboarding, skill enhancement, and ongoing educational initiatives- Collaborating on event planning and execution alongside our Guest Service Agent Events- Achieving revenue goals while managing cost budgets- Upholding hygiene standards and maintaining cleanliness in our F&B spaces- Building and managing relationships with local suppliers, in line with the Motel One Group's central procurement- Participation in the conception and design of our F&B offers- Enforcing workplace cleanliness and compliance with hygiene regulations- Collaborating seamlessly across departments and brandsBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.QualificationsWhether you're a professional in the hotel industry or considering a career change, we're enthusiastic about meeting you! For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:- Experience in hospitality, gastronomy, or tourism, ideally within F&B- Passion for hospitality and team leadership- Strong commitment to quality and service excellence- Awareness of trends in gastronomy, events, and design- Proactive nature and eagerness to develop and implement innovative concepts (e.g., F&B offerings or events)- Entrepreneurial mindset, organizational skills, and proficiency in MS Office- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments

jobs.description: **Location:**  GhentClient confidentialTransport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business Are you the one?- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.- Well-being services- Restaurant on site- Opportunity to grow within the company- Good work life balance- International environment- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Wielsbeke site, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician in 2 shifts. As a preventive maintenance technician, you are passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these findings accurately, allowing us to act proactively and minimise unplanned downtime. 
 
• You perform scheduled maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
 
• You work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
 
• You provide external employees with the necessary support and follow-up to make their contribution effective and efficient. You also supervise technical trainees and new employees to help them grow in their roles. 
 
• You keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo). 

 
 
• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues 
 
• You are willing to work in a 2-shift regime

Mechnical Design Engineer (R&D Professional) 
 

Company
 

Xeikon is a world-leading innovator in digital printing, focusing on labels and packaging, commercial print, and related applications. Operating in an industrial capital goods environment, Xeikon designs, develops, manufactures and markets high-quality digital colour printers and presses.
 

Xeikon is part of Flint Group. Its pioneering products and services form the foundation of Flint Group Digital Printing Solutions. This division broadens Flint Group’s portfolio of conventional and digital printing solutions, offering a unique combination of equipment, consumables and services to customers worldwide.
 

 
 

Mission
 

As a member of the 
R&D Electromechanical Design team, you will contribute directly to the development of next-generation digital printing engines. You will take responsibility for mechanical designs that translate innovative ideas into reliable, industrial-grade products.
 

 
 

Main Responsibilities (see attachement for all details)

Profile
 

· You hold a 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in (electro)mechanical engineering or industrial design.
 

· You have 
3–5 years of experience in mechanical design within an industrial or high-tech environment.
 

· You have solid knowledge of 
manufacturing techniques, such as machining, sheet metal, injection moulding, extrusion and 3D printing, including their capabilities and limitations.
 

· You have experience with 
3D CAD software, preferably 
PTC Creo.
 

· You have a strong understanding of 
mechanical physics.
 

· You are a 
hands-on team player with good communication skills in 
Dutch and English.
 

· You are analytical, solution-oriented and able to work independently.
 

· You are eager to learn, resilient under pressure and motivated by technical challenges.

R&D Project Manager Inkjet
 

Flint Group Digital Xeikon 
 | 
 Lier, Belgium 
 | 
 Full-time
 

Lead industrial inkjet development from business case to market introduction, bringing multidisciplinary teams together to turn customer needs into production-ready printing solutions.
 

About Flint Group Digital Xeikon and the role
 

Flint Group Digital Xeikon, part of Flint Group, develops digital printing solutions for labels and packaging. As R&D Project Manager, you will lead projects across our inkjet portfolio, including Panther UV inkjet label presses and IDERA aqueous inkjet solutions for corrugated applications.
 

Reporting to the Director Inkjet & Program Management, you will guide development, validation, industrialisation and launch, leading cross-functional teams through collaboration and influence.
 

What you will do
 

--> see attachement
 

What you bring
 

• 
 A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, applied science or technology, or equivalent relevant experience.
 

• 
 At least five years of project management experience in complex industrial product development, including work with external suppliers or development partners.
 

• 
 Strong planning, budget and risk management skills, with experience of validation, industrialisation and structured project reviews.
 

• 
 The technical judgement to work across disciplines, communicate clearly and align stakeholders without formal authority.
 

• 
 Professional proficiency in English and willingness to travel internationally when projects require it. Dutch or other languages are an advantage.
 

Industrial inkjet, digital printing, capital equipment or hardware/software development experience is an advantage. Project management certification is welcome but not essential.
 

Why join us
 

Own technically challenging projects with a direct impact on Flint Group Digital Xeikon’s global inkjet portfolio. Collaborate with engineering specialists and international partners, and help improve how we develop and deliver products. Hybrid working is available in line with company policy. We offer a salary package with fringe benefits in line with the market.
 

Interested
 

Apply with your CV and a short introduction highlighting your experience in industrial product development and project delivery.

Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
